name: interview-journey
description: Evidence-driven technical interview preparation: role and resume analysis, fit and gap analysis, preparation strategy, question prediction, mock interviews, answer coaching, post-interview debriefs, and offer-negotiation preparation.

interface.longDescription: Interview Journey prepares you for technical interviews using your real resume, the target role, and your current interview stage. It builds role and resume analysis, fit and gap analysis, a focused preparation strategy, likely questions, mock interviews, answer coaching, post-interview debriefs, and offer-negotiation preparation. It works only from information you provide and never invents experience, monitors, or automates anything on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: Here is the job description and my resume. Analyze the role and my fit.
I have a system design interview next week. Build my preparation plan.
Run a mock behavioral interview and coach my answers.
